decisions.reason: The transactional email service builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and was featured on the home page, so the firm's own R&D lets it interpret results and keep improving it.
Managed capture services extend the firm's established document workflow offer, have a dedicated page and a documented customer reference, and fit its digital-process strategy.
Email and fax conversion uses the firm's existing fax and email infrastructure, so it is cheap to maintain and well understood, even though fax demand is slowly declining.
This fax delivery optimization feature sits close to the core fax service the firm knows well, though as a minor feature it could be folded into the base offer.
Sandbox threat protection builds on the firm's email security know-how and growing security demand, and its R&D capacity supports assimilating threat intelligence.
